maya: heads-up — nightly h100 job (gpu-smoke/cuda-compat) started failing on canary nodes after we bumped CUDA Toolkit to 12.3 on the builder images. Seeing repeated mmap() ENOMEM + segfault in libnvidia-ml.so. ci link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/25123. pinging eng-ml
ci-bot: build 25123 failed: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/25123 | failing test: tests/gpu/test_mmap_alloc.py::test_mmap_zeroed — logs attached
jonathan: can you paste the tail of the log? also which driver version on canary? we bumped toolkits but drivers need matching
maya: driver is 535.101 on canary; older nodes run 525.60 and pass. log snippet: ```[mmap(0x7f...) = -1 ENOMEM] SIGSEGV at 0x0; dmesg: NVRM: Xid 31 (GPU page fault)```
drew: hmm could be driver/toolkit ABI skew or libc/kernel interaction with the new base image. repro locally with: `docker run --gpus all -it image:cuda-12.3 /bin/bash -c 'pytest tests/gpu/test_mmap_alloc.py::test_mmap_zeroed -q'` — can someone try a single-run on a canary node?
sam: i kicked a single-run on canary and reproduced. dmesg shows `NVRM: Xid 31` + `GPU memory page fault` and the test fails with `IOError: mmap failed: [Errno 12] Cannot allocate memory`. trying a couple env toggles: `export CUDA_MEMORYPOOL=1` to force mempool path — still fails.
jonathan: quick sanity: can we try the same container but with driver 525.60 pinned? if that fixes it it's driver/toolkit mismatch. maya, can you spawn a node with 525 and retest?
maya: launching a canary with 525.60 now, will run the single test and post results. attaching current stderr excerpt: ```Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/gpu/test_mmap_alloc.py", line 42, in test_mmap_zeroed
    buf = mmap.mmap(-1, size)
OSError: [Errno 12] Cannot allocate memory
```
ci-bot: rerun requested by @maya — job https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/25123/rerun/1 started (manual rerun)
maya: quick update — 525.60 driver canary passed the single test. looks like toolkit/driver incompat. will revert toolkit bump in the builder image and open a follow-up to coordinate driver rollouts. assigning to @drew for rollback PR :eyes:
drew: on it, opening PR #439 to pin the toolkit to 12.2 in `infra/images/gpu/Dockerfile` and adding a small matrix job to catch driver/toolkit skew. i'll also notify infra to schedule a driver rollout window so we don't mismatch again.
sam: added a short reproducer script to `dev-resources/gpu-repros/repro-mmap.sh` and a note in the incidents doc. if anyone sees other mmap-like failures, drop logs here so we can correlate. :thumbsup:
